description: The file defines a Flutter widget for a media player screen, including state management for playback position, play/pause toggle, seeking, and persistence of progress, along with UI components.

classes.name: PlayerScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a media playback UI with controls for play, pause, seek, and progress persistence.

classes.name: _PlayerScreenState
classes.description: State class for PlayerScreen managing playback state, timer, and UI updates.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes playback position and starts the ticker timer.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _startTicker
methods.description: Starts or resets the periodic timer to update playback position.

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles between play and pause states.

methods.name: seekBy
methods.description: Adjusts playback position by a delta in seconds.

methods.name: persistProgress
methods.description: Persists current playback position to repository and signals progress saved.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks playback as completed, resets position, and signals completion.

methods.name: _format
methods.description: Formats seconds into a string mm:ss or ss.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree including UI for video surface, controls, and playback info.
